### **My takeaway:** 
She is productive and loves what she does. Watching this made me realise the potential of what data analytics could offer and what I could achieve from it. I have strived for a day such as this one ever since. Combined with knowledge from my degree and the part-time work I have accumulated in two languages, I have what it takes to work in a fast-paced, demanding environment. Similar to the data analytics specialisation, there was always something new to learn and I am glad to have developed my technical abilities alongside this module.
